name: MKP Mobility Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, MKP Mobility Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and trading activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MKPML is an automobile spare parts distributor in India. The company sells over 60,000 SKUs and caters to over 4,000 customers across the country.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.66 Cr.
